question: Is signal delivery ordering a deterministic function of virtual time, across backends?
method: strict + verify double-run; plus plain runs for cross-backend ordering; pinned env
finding: SIGUSR and SIGCHLD deliver and are deterministic + cross-backend identical. ITIMER_REAL/SIGALRM is NEVER DELIVERED under hermit (0 vs 5 native) while --verify still reports 'Success: deterministic' -- a vacuous pass over zero deliveries.
benign_explanation_refuted: virtual elapsed over the same loop is 52.011 ms under hermit vs 13.576 ms native; a 1 ms repeating timer was long overdue, so this is not a too-short-loop artifact
not_a_fix: Per #140 the fix must NOT coarsen or freeze time. Virtual time is advancing correctly (52ms); the defect is that ITIMER_REAL expiry is not wired to it.
